FINDING: the docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:255 line anomaly is explained — the reporting path is exonerated.

Evidence (git archaeology, 2026-07-26):
- Test files are .exs: ExUnit compiles them from disk at run time, no beam cache. An artifact event's line therefore always reflects the on-disk file AT RUN START, not any stale compile.
- The cz0 session's branch (specled_-cz0/spec-honesty, still alive) shows seven micro-commits touching this exact file. Across them, test 'a fabricated, unmarked finding code IS flagged' sat at lines 182, 231, 242, 250, 256, 266, 268 — the file churned +/-6 lines around 255 all session.
- 4c9aa6864 has that test at 250 and the 'evidence/*' test head at 256/257 with 255 blank — precisely the state the original comment describes inspecting. Adjacent states (833a83fe, 966464d9) have an @tag at 255 and a test decl at 256.
- Conclusion: the failing run executed an uncommitted working state where a test declaration sat at 255; the 'line 255 is blank' inspection read a different (shifted) state. 'No edits between runs' was wrong at file granularity — the session was editing this exact file between spec.check invocations.

Impact on this ticket's scope: the descriptor-id change is MORE valuable, not less — a test NAME is shift-proof where a line number is not; this failure mode (report generated against tree state A, investigated against tree state B) will recur in any session that edits between gate runs. Two scope additions worth making: (1) preserve the attribution artifact JSONL alongside the SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR capture on failure (run_merged_command's `after File.rm(artifact_path)` currently destroys it — it is primary evidence); (2) have the forensic capture record run-time provenance (git rev-parse HEAD + dirty-file list) so report-vs-inspection tree skew is detectable next time.

Still genuinely open: WHY a doc-integrity lint test failed once-in-five under load (the assertions near every candidate line are pure-constant), and the verifier_test.exs:1452 site. Both need the armed forensics; neither needs the reporting path investigated further.

8e78cb9f, and re-applies all eight mutations in the isolated clone; the contaminated
2-failure result for mutation (a) was replaced by a clean re-run. The disclosure is
complete and the residual risk (a possibly destroyed uncommitted edit in
verifier.ex) is about the implementer's work surviving, not about the evidence
being sound — and the file at HEAD contains the wording that edit would have had.
The process finding stands on its own; it is not a reason to distrust this record.
